description: Command-line tool that scaffolds Spring Boot projects pre-configured with Thymeleaf or JTE, a live-reload setup (DevTools, NPM or Vite) and web dependencies like Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, htmx and Alpine.js.
rules: Run `ttcli init` to create a new project; it creates a sub-directory named after the artifactId in the current directory (override with `--baseDir`).
Always read the HELP.md in the generated project to learn how to start the live-reload setup that was selected.
Install via Homebrew (`brew install wimdeblauwe/homebrew-ttcli/ttcli`), Chocolatey (`choco install ttcli`), JBang (`jbang run ttcli@wimdeblauwe init`) or the release zips on GitHub.
